import json,re
from pathlib import Path
s=json.load(open("system-spec/spec-state.json"))
qa={q["id"]:q for q in s["qa_log"]}
ap={a["id"]:a for a in s["approval_log"]}
for d in s["decisions"]:
    q=qa.get(d["qa_ref"]); print(d["id"],d["qa_ref"],q and q.get("basis"), "user_decision",d["user_decision"], "rec",d["recommendation"].get("option_id") or list(d["recommendation"].keys()))
rf=s["requirements_foundation"]; print("confirmed",rf["confirmed"],"approval_ref",rf["approval_ref"], rf["approval_ref"] in ap)
print("goals",rf["goals"]); print("objectives",rf["objectives"]); print("intents",rf["concrete_intents"])
for p in sorted(Path("system-spec").rglob("*.md")):
    t=p.read_text()
    fm=t.split("---")[1] if t.startswith("---") else ""
    heads=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith("#")]
    print("=====",p, "\nFM:",fm.strip().replace("\n"," | ")); print("HEADS:"," / ".join(heads))
EOF
